_readme: Copy bank for the structured-content generator. The voice is a tailor speaking in confidence: low, declarative, slightly arch. Editorial, never marketing-speak. Edit freely — every line here should survive the voice linter (no emoji, no exclamation points, no buzzwords).

craft.label: Craft
craft.principle: Take the making seriously. Quality is never the thing that gets cut.
hooks: The fabric decides most things. We listen to it.
A garment is a few thousand decisions. We make each one slowly.
Before it fits you, it passes through hands that have done this for seventeen years.
Cloth from mills that have earned their names. Work that intends to earn ours.
bodies: Every piece is cut to a single pattern — yours. The cloth comes from heritage mills; the construction comes from a master tailor who has spent seventeen years learning what to leave out.
We obsess over fabric, construction, and the hands behind every piece. Quality is never the thing that gets cut.
Made to measure, by hand, refined with every order. The first fitting is the hardest one you will ever do. Each one after is easier, and closer.
signoffs: Fabric milled in Italy. Crafted in Vietnam.
Made to measure. Made to last.

ease.label: Ease
ease.principle: Remove every decision possible. Never make him think hard.
hooks: Ease is a tailoring term. It is the room a garment leaves for a life.
You have enough decisions. The showroom is where they stop.
Soft shoulders, no lining where none is needed, cloth that moves first.
bodies: We choose the fabric and handle the fit. You say yes or no. Measurements are saved after the first order, so every piece after is easier and more precise.
Ease is built into the experience and cut into the cloth — unstructured tailoring that follows the body through an actual day, not a fitting room.
The clothes are comfortable and easy to wear, and they fit into more than one life: the office, the flight, the long dinner.
signoffs: Say yes or no. We handle the rest.

brotherhood.label: Brotherhood
brotherhood.principle: Build for and with the community. Not a customer base — a crew.
headlines: The Clothes Are Serious. The People Are Not.
hooks: No one finds us by accident. Members arrive through someone they trust.
A customer base is counted. A crew is known by name.
The best introduction is still a friend saying: you should meet my tailor.
bodies: Private Pattern grows by nomination. Each member arrives through someone they trust, which means the room is already full of people worth knowing.
The brand belongs to the members. Their measurements, their referrals, their standards — we are only the ones holding the chalk.
The community is self-selected: shared taste, shared standards, no velvet rope theatre. The clothes are serious. The people are not.
signoffs: The room is warm. The door is quiet.

intention.label: Intention
intention.principle: Nothing is accidental. If there is no reason for it, it is removed. Tỉ mỉ.
headlines: If There Is No Reason, It Is Removed
hooks: There is a Vietnamese word for it: tỉ mỉ. Meticulous, patient, exact.
Every stitch, every fabric, every word is deliberate.
The quietest luxury is knowing why everything is the way it is.
bodies: Every choice is made with intention — design, fabric, cut — and made for you. If a detail has no reason to exist, it is removed before it reaches the table.
Tỉ mỉ is not a slogan; it is a working method. Patient hands, exact seams, decisions that answer to a reason.
We remove what is accidental until what remains is deliberate. That is the whole aesthetic.

heritage.label: Heritage
heritage.principle: Redefine Made in Vietnam — prove Vietnamese craftsmanship belongs at the top of menswear.
hooks: Made in Vietnam is not a disclaimer. Here, it is the headline.
Italian mills weave the cloth. Vietnamese hands give it a spine.
Some labels hide where the work is done. We put it on the selvage.
bodies: Private Pattern exists to prove a point: Vietnamese craftsmanship belongs at the top of menswear, next to the mills whose cloth it cuts.
The tradition is real — patient hands, exact work, pride in the seam. We built the bridge so the rest of the world could walk across it.
Every order sends the same message: the words Made in Vietnam can sit inside a jacket that answers to no one.
signoffs: Fabric milled in Italy. Finished at home.
The proof is in the seam.

hooks: Elevated casual menswear. Crafted exclusively for our members.
bodies: Custom elevated casual tailoring. Fabric milled in Italy, crafted in Vietnam, cut to a single pattern — yours.

closeHeadlines: Ask the Member Who Sent You
closeBodies: Membership moves by referral. If you know someone in the crew, you already have a way in.
One fitting. Every measurement remembered. Each piece after, easier and closer.
The showroom is quiet, the decisions are few, and the cloth is already chosen.
